changelog: Plain `apm audit` renders advisory drift as `[!] Drift detected` and prints `[x]` only when drift fails the run via `fail_on_drift` (#4217)

ledger_row.summary: Plain apm audit printed an [x] Drift detected error line for advisory drift while exiting 0, so the line severity contradicted the documented exit contract.

red: APM_BINARY_PATH="$(uv run which apm)" uv run --extra dev pytest 'tests/integration/test_audit_drift_exit_contract_lifecycle.py::test_plain_audit_drift_line_severity_matches_exit_code[advisory]' -n 0 -p no:cacheprovider -q -> FAILED at test_audit_drift_exit_contract_lifecycle.py:86: assert ('[x] Drift detected: 1 file(s)' in [...]) is False (bare audit exited 0 with an [x] drift line)
green: same command over the module -> 2 passed (advisory: [!] header + exit 0; fail-on-drift: [x] header + exit 1); neighbours: 323 passed, 1 skipped (drift/audit unit, integration, spec_conformance) and 582 passed (tests/unit -k audit)
owner: src/apm_cli/install/drift_render.py (render_drift_text advisory=) + src/apm_cli/commands/audit.py (bare-audit drift gate decides advisory vs failing)
notes: Documented contract (docs/src/content/docs/reference/cli/audit.md 'Exit codes', content scan mode): code 0 covers 'advisory drift without security.audit.fail_on_drift'; code 1 covers 'drift-check failures promoted by security.audit.fail_on_drift'. Fix keeps that contract and renders advisory drift as [!] so an [x] drift line implies a non-zero exit. fail_on_drift is now resolved whenever drift fails (previously skipped when exit was already 1), so the [x] severity is correct even when other findings already fail the run. --ci rendering and JSON/SARIF levels are unchanged. The stderr progress line from CheckLogger.findings stays '[!] Drift detected' in both modes (unchanged). Docs updated: reference/cli/audit.md, troubleshooting/index.md. No overlap with #4138; #4143 (output rewrites) may touch drift_render.py hint text -- trivial merge expected.
